title: Enthalpy-Based Thermal Response and Its Exact Relation to the Speed of Sound in Finite-Temperature QCD
summary: A precise characterization of the QCD phase transition remains a fundamental open problem, primarily due to the intrinsically non-perturbative nature of the dynamics that govern the breakdown of We quantify the logarithmic thermal variation of the normalized enthalpy density in finite-temperature Quantum Chromodynamics using a dimensionless response thermal function, $\mathcal{H}(T)$. We establish an exact identity that links $\mathcal{H}(T)$ to the speed of sound, $c_s^2(T)$.
